t: Google Search Console API Python Example: Trend Analysis
s: This article demonstrates how to use the Google Search Console API with Python to retrieve granular data for trend analysis. It focuses on setting up authentication via GCP Service Accounts and fetching the most recent date with available data to enable detailed query/page performance insights beyond the GSC web UI limits.
